entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: You guys just don't know when to stop.[n]Is the hit on me really that big?

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: What clan are you from?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Clan?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Does he mean like, yakuza clan?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wait, does he "clean up" problems by[n]making people disappear?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Crap... Is he really yakuza!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems that bastard Shido has close ties[n]to the underground...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How are we supposed to get the letter of[n]introduction from him? Do we have to[n]prove our worth?

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: Hey!

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: I'm a busy man.

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: I gotta deal with cleanin' up problems[n]and all them mental shutdowns, after all.

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: If you got business with me, just spit it out[n]already.
Give me a letter...
May I have a letter?
How much for a letter?

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: A letter of introduction? Why the hell[n]would I give you one?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: As I expected...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ummm... Actually, we're here to suggest[n]a tattoo design for you.

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: A tattoo?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Th-This guy is great at drawing...[n]H-He's an artist!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What is the meaning of this!? I have no[n]intention of designing a simple tattoo!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I thought you'd be able to do it, Yusuke...

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: What're you squabblin' about?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yusuke, draw something! Art's art,[n]ain't it!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Very well. May I at least decide what[n]I draw?

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: Uh-uh. I won't accept anything 'cept[n]a godly phoenix fitting for my godly[n]personality.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A phoenix... I'd rather something else...

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: Makin' excuses now, mister "artist"?[n]You're all talk. People like you are[n]a dime a dozen.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I am not all talk. I can draw anything you[n]want.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Bring me a brush and a piece of paper.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...It's finished.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, this is totally not gonna work for[n]a tattoo...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is it a monster? It has some kinda crazy[n]aura...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: A truly... explosive piece...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is my perception of a phoenix.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's no way this is gonna work...

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: I ain't seen nothing like this before! I like it!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Thank you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It seems like... it went well?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well then, I request a letter of[n]introduction.

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: On one condition, kid. I want you to be[n]my personal tattoo artist.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He wants to recruit you!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I decline.

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: No letter for you then.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I must decide my own path as an artist. I[n]will not receive aid from others any[n]longer.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now if you understand, hand over the[n]letter.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Otherwise we'll just have to take it by[n]force. By the way, you're more feral[n]pigeon than phoenix.

entries.speaker: Shadow Cleaner
entries.en: You cocky-ass bastard! I'm gonna[n]destroy you! I'll rip you open and[n]tear out your insides!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're still gonna fight after all that!?
